CustomField.label: Fraud Alert Technical Contact Email
CustomField.description: Fixed technical/admin contact address notified when the Fraud_Alert Flow itself encounters an internal error (a lookup or update failure), as opposed to Fraud_Alert_Recipient_Emails__c which is notified about actual fraud-signal matches. Comma-separated if multiple. Leave blank to skip technical-failure notifications (not recommended - failures will only be visible via Fraud_Alert_Processing_Error__c on the affected Application record).
